newsitem.title: CENTRAL AFRICAN REPUBLIC: Central African truce extended - government.
newsitem.headline: Central African truce extended - government.

text.p: The Central African Republic government and army mutineers signed an accord on Sunday extending for one month a ceasefire in the capital Bangui, a presidential spokesman said.

A 15-day truce that expired earlier on Sunday will continue in place until January 23, during which time rebels and loyalist troops would maintain their positions, spokesman Theophile Doumbe told Reuters.
The accord was signed by President Ange-Felix Patasse and rebel leader Captain Anicet Saulet as well as mediator General Amadou Toumani Toure, former military ruler of Mali.
